text: This dissertation presents a study of the phonological system of Sgaw Karen, an under-described Sino-Tibetan language spoken in Burma and Thailand as well as in diaspora communities worldwide. Particular attention is given to clarifying the distinct acoustic dimensions used by Karen speakers in the production of tone.

text: Sgaw Karen (ကညီကျိာ် / K'nyaw) Sgaw Karen is a member of the Karenic branch of the Sino-Tibetan language family.
